## Summary
- Route all review `HUMAN_DECISION` handoffs to `agent-self-approve` when self-approval is enabled, including `MINOR_ISSUES` and `NEEDS_REWORK` verdicts.
- Allow self-approval preflight to run as a decision gate for current-head non-`SHIP` syntheses with handoff context, while preserving the deterministic rule that actual approval requires trusted current-head `SHIP` provenance.
- Update self-approval/orchestrator prompts, docs, and regression tests for the broader decision-gate behavior.

## Verification
- `npm run build`
- `node --test dist/__tests__/handoff.test.js dist/__tests__/dispatch-agent-orchestrator-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/prepare-self-approve-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/self-approval.test.js dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #263

comments.body:
The size grew because #264 changed the requirement from #262’s narrow case to a broader one.

#262 only needed: `SHIP + HUMAN_DECISION + self-approval enabled -> agent-self-approve`.

#264 now also needs: `MINOR_ISSUES/NEEDS_REWORK + HUMAN_DECISION -> agent-self-approve`, while still preventing actual GitHub approval unless the trusted current-head review verdict is `SHIP`. That forced changes in self-approval preflight/result safety, not just handoff routing: `.agent/src/cli/prepare-self-approve.ts`, `.agent/src/self-approval.ts`, `.github/prompts/agent-self-approve.md`, and new tests. That is why it grew from ~11 files / 380 additions in #262 to 16 files / 535 additions in #264. Most of the growth is tests.

But I agree with your second point: the current prompt/context is still wrong.

The routing logic is closer now:

- [`handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e93f433be9fe66d75fa7cbf220aeb929ecbc00b9/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L504-L517) dispatches any review `HUMAN_DECISION` to `agent-self-approve` when self-approval is enabled.

The wrong part is that the prompt/context still says self-approval may “block for a human decision”:

- [`handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e93f433be9fe66d75fa7cbf220aeb929ecbc00b9/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L89-L92)
- [`handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e93f433be9fe66d75fa7cbf220aeb929ecbc00b9/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L240-L243)
- [`agent-orchestrator.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e93f433be9fe66d75fa7cbf220aeb929ecbc00b9/.github/prompts/agent-orchestrator.md#L81-L85)
- [`agent-self-approve.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/e93f433be9fe66d75fa7cbf220aeb929ecbc00b9/.github/prompts/agent-self-approve.md#L28-L33)

That contradicts the desired model. When self-approval is enabled, `HUMAN_DECISION` should mean “route this judgment to the self-approval gate,” not “maybe send it back to a human.”

Concrete fix for #264:

- Keep `HUMAN_DECISION + self-approval enabled -> agent-self-approve`.
- Remove “block for a human decision” wording from the handoff context and prompts.
- Tell self-approval: make the decision itself.
  - `SHIP`: may `APPROVE` if safe.
  - non-`SHIP`: must not approve; return `REQUEST_CHANGES` when concrete work exists, or `BLOCKED` only for automation/safety/missing-context failure, not as a normal human-decision fallback.
- Update the tests to assert the prompt/context no longer reintroduces “human decision” as the outcome.

So yes: #264 is bigger for a real reason, but the prompt/wording should be tightened before merge.

title: Route human-decision reviews through self-approval
